findings.location: G.4 endpoint-list extension on the null infinite-query event
findings.initial_issue: An arbitrary modification on a null set need not be measurable on the allowed noncomplete tape probability space.
findings.counterexample: Borel [0,1] with Borel Lebesgue probability; a non-Borel subset V of a null Cantor set Z; choose different finite endpoint lists on V and its complement. The list length is not measurable.
findings.adopted_repair: On the measurable null event of infinite-query tapes, define the list to be (0,1). This fixed extension preserves measurability. The following replay sentence is explicitly restricted to outside that null event.
findings.theorem_scope_effect: None; fixes the chosen representative on a measurable null event.

findings.location: Common model definition and G.1 measurable protocol convention
findings.initial_issue: Joint measurability was the natural intended reading, but was not explicit; separate measurability would not justify adaptive composition.
findings.counterexample_to_weaker_interpretation: d(omega,r)=1 iff omega=r is in a non-Borel V. Each one-variable section is Borel, but after Eval([0,omega]) on the uniform profile the decision is the nonmeasurable diagonal 1_V(omega).
findings.adopted_repair: Standard Borel finite transcript/action/output encoding spaces; next-action and finite-output rules jointly measurable in tape and finite transcript; semantic query-free nonreturn type without a decidability assumption.
findings.theorem_scope_effect: Clarifies the standard joint-measurable model. Ordinary countable-step measurable oracle protocols remain covered. Merely separately measurable rules are explicitly excluded; they can fail to induce measurable adaptive executions.

independent_derivations: For legal roots, |z-zprime| <= 4||F-Fprime||_infinity + 3|a-aprime| + 2|t-tprime|; the legal domain and oracle failure tags are Borel.
Joint histories follow by finite composition and measurable dummy-state extensions.
With reach events R_k, {Q=k}=R_k minus R_(k+1) and {Q=infinity}=intersection R_k. Return, terminal-illegal, and nonreturn strata are measurable without a last-query stopping-time condition.
Finite output code strata provide measurable endpoint vectors, counts, ownership, gaps and success. Fixed null-set extension avoids completeness assumptions.
Bounded domination of min(1,2hN) and decreasing positive-gap events give a common deterministic dyadic width without E[N]<infinity.
Old failure and decoder events give the failure inclusion after measurable loss events and the measurable null infinite-query event are removed.
Tonelli averages a jointly measurable bounded failure indicator over fixed pulse tuples; no regular conditional law, full-profile-space measurable structure, or tape-dependent selection is used.
